description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class in an Android application, using Robolectric to simulate Android runtime environment. It tests the migration of legacy preference values and the persistence of gateway tokens.

classes.name: SecurePrefsTest
classes.description: Test class for SecurePrefs, verifying preference migration and token persistence behaviors.

methods.name: loadLocationMode_migratesLegacyAlwaysValue
methods.description: Test that verifies migration from legacy 'always' value to the new LocationMode.WhileUsing setting.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken_persistsSeparatelyFromSharedToken
methods.description: Test that checks separate persistence of gateway token and bootstrap token in shared preferences.
